status: retained baseline measurement; source revision is recorded separately; not flight performance

provenance.runtime_s: unavailable: report builder does not time simulation

hash_parity.manifest_sha256: sha256 of retained manifest.json bytes if present

sampling.time_semantics: S0 post-step time: each row is the state at the end of its step. sample_count and duration_s describe the 700 logged rows (first row at t = 0.01 s). step_response metrics prepend the configured t = 0 initial state, so step_response.count is 701 samples spanning 0 to 7 s

definitions.rise: first sample at rise_fraction of step amplitude
definitions.overshoot: peak beyond goal divided by step amplitude
definitions.settling: first sample after which all samples stay within tolerance of goal

unavailable_metrics.packet_loss: No packet events in S0 telemetry
unavailable_metrics.packet_age: No shared-clock observation timestamps in S0 telemetry
unavailable_metrics.detection_reacquisition: No detection availability events in S0 telemetry
unavailable_metrics.controller_recovery: No outage and settled-window events in S0 telemetry
unavailable_metrics.miss_distance: No target trajectory/capture event in S0 telemetry

known_issues: Sampled-controller limit: attitude rate damping of 18 per second needs dt < 2/18 = 0.111 s (necessary condition; the controller rejects larger steps). Sideways steps are tested to converge at dt 0.01 s for four targets and four starting yaw angles, not at every dt below the limit.
No heading setpoint: the controller damps yaw rate but does not hold or command a yaw angle.
No ground plane: the body can descend below z = 0 without contact.
No integral action: a steady thrust shortfall leaves a small steady position error.

Default inertia (0.0023, 0.0023, 0.0040 kg m^2) is a fixed estimate for a 450 g 5-inch frame and is not derived from mass. Hardware-profile vehicles use a point-mass plus plate estimate. Neither is measured.
Drag coefficient, reference area, and controller gains are synthetic scenario inputs, not measured values.
This artifact only runs the vertical step to (0, 0, 3) m; sideways and yawed cases are covered by tests, not by this run.

RK4 stages use the attitude quaternion without renormalizing it inside a step (it is renormalized after each step). The effect is small: the measured convergence ratio is still about 16 per halving of dt.
